title: Gateway
description: Where the gateway listens, how long a request waits for a model that is starting or switching, whether it answers OpenCode's session titles itself, and what it keeps of each request.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

start.description: Start the gateway when the service starts, and again whenever it is found not running.
start.title: Start with the service

port.description: Where tools reach the gateway, on this machine only.
port.title: Port

proxy_port.description: Where the agent's internet requests enter Clank's proxy (design 0024), on this machine only; the edge forwards it to the containers.
proxy_port.title: Proxy port

hold_seconds.description: How long a request waits, in seconds, for a slot that is starting or switching, before refusal.
hold_seconds.title: Hold

local_titles.description: Answer OpenCode's session-title requests in the gateway, so they never take the place of the conversation the engine keeps cached (design 0001 §6.4).
local_titles.title: Answer titles here

loop_guard.description: Stop an answer that repeats itself: the engine stops writing it, and the stream ends with an error that says what repeated (design 0004 §2). A change applies when the gateway restarts: clank gateway restart.
loop_guard.title: Loop guard

loop_windows.description: The stretches of the thinking and the text that the loop guard reads, their newest characters: a short one finds a short repeat soon, a long one prose said again every 600 to 800 characters.
loop_windows.title: Loop stretches

loop_tool_windows.description: The stretches of a tool call's arguments that the loop guard reads: the short one only, since a file written from a template (records that differ by an id, rows of a table) compresses over a long stretch as far as a loop does.
loop_tool_windows.title: Loop stretches, tool calls

loop_ratio.description: A part repeats itself when a stretch compresses to under this share of its size (real answers stay above 0.18; the measurement of 2026-10-18).
loop_ratio.title: Loop share

records.description: Keep each request and its answer in logs/traffic.
records.title: Keep requests

record_limit_kib.description: The longest text kept of one field of a request or answer, in KiB.
record_limit_kib.title: Field limit

keep_days.description: How many days of requests are kept.
keep_days.title: Days kept

network_days.description: How many days of the agent's internet exchanges are kept (logs/network, design 0024 §4).
network_days.title: Network days kept
